notes: A 26-year-old motorcyclist was killed in 2015 by a bus turning left. The insurer's 30% przyczynienie was rejected (no evidence), so there was no reduction. Six plaintiffs: parents (100 000 appropriate each, 21 000 paid), brother (89 500, 10 500 paid), three grandparents (40 000 each; the grandfather died during the case and his award goes to his heir H. M.). The father also got 100 000 under art. 446 § 3 (his income collapsed). The joint parental odszkodowanie of 8 792.88 (16 316.72 withdrawn) is recorded under the mother only, to avoid double counting.
